entries.title: Typing a reply on your iPhone or iPad can't press a card's choices by mistake
entries.body: While you type a reply under a card on your iPhone or iPad, its choices and a note's Done or Got it dim in place. A tap on one then only puts the keyboard down, so a tap meant for send can't decide the card; tap again to choose, with your words.
entries.noPicture: The change is on iPhone and iPad, and release pictures are taken from the Mac window, which this change leaves as it was.
